scene: Atop the stairs, a windswept transit roof opens wide.
picture: Along a wide stone transit rooftop, a glass-tubed spiral lift stands open at far left. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands at left-center. A striped mountain cable tram waits on roof tracks at centre, and a lantern-lit wooden river barge floats beside a canal gate at far right.
shown: a glass-tubed spiral lift with an open door at far left
a striped mountain cable tram waiting on a roof track at centre
a lantern-lit wooden river barge docked by a roof canal at far right
